name: cohort-retention
title: Cohort Retention
description: Cohort retention with missing observations distinguished from zero.
usage: <CohortRetention cohorts={[{ id: "w1", label: "W01", size: 80, retained: [80, 45, null] }]} />
useCases: In a subscription report, an analyst compares the share of users in different signup cohorts who returned a week later.
In a course dashboard, a curriculum lead distinguishes a future cohort week from a completed week in which nobody returned.
task: Show returning participants by cohort and period.
behavior: size is the cohort size. retained contains the number returning in each period. Use null for future or unobserved periods.
